claimChanges.claimText: Web of Science Research Assistant is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.
Scopus AI is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

Microsoft Copilot with commercial data protection is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.
Kontra translation engine is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: self hosted system.
Helka AI search is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.
DALL-E 3 via Microsoft Copilot is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.
CurreChat is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.
Avidnote AI assistant is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.
aTrain is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

University of Helsinki research guidance supports responsible and critical use of GenAI in research, but says researchers are responsible for outputs, should verify them, describe substantial GenAI use, and must not list GenAI as a co-author.
University of Helsinki IT guidance says Copilot may only be used for public or open data and not personal data, while CurreChat may process internal data but not confidential or secret data.

University of Helsinki identifies Microsoft Copilot with commercial data protection and CurreChat as its general-purpose generative AI services and recommends primarily using University-supported AI services.
